mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts, as measured by HOUST, indicates a growing demand for housing and, by extension, a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, below 6% indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the unemployment rate is below 6% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production, as measured by INDPRO, above 2% indicates a growing supply of goods and services, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when industrial production growth is above 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales, as measured by RSAFS, and a decrease in the unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, indicate a growing demand for goods and services and a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when retail sales growth is strong and the unemployment rate is low (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, and an increase in the money supply, as measured by CPIAUCSL, indicate an accommodative monetary policy and a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is low and the money supply is growing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in payroll employment, as measured by PAYEMS, and a decrease in the unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, indicate a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when payroll employment growth is strong and the unemployment rate is low (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP, as measured by GDPC1, below 2% indicates a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when GDP growth is below 2% (t-test p > 0.05).
